recommendation: Reach goal, auction, weekly target frequency 3.4, cap 4 per 7 days, lifetime budget $18,000 over 28 days (4 weeks).
key_findings: Results level off after 3.0 to 4.0 exposures a week: the 4.0 and up band added 1.62 link clicks per 1,000 reached per extra exposure, 40% of the first band's 4.0. Level-off point 3.4, so the cap is 4 per 7 days.
Past flights spent $7,570.33 (18.9% of the kept spend) in 3 weeks at or past 4.0 exposures. A link click cost $2.78 there against $2.18 in the weeks below.
At $8.59 CPM, $4,500 a week buys about 523,865 impressions, or 154,078 people at 3.4 each: 6.7% of the audience's lower bound, inside the 50% limit.
Auction, not reservation: the user needs no guaranteed delivery, so the first condition fails even though the audience is large enough.

goal_choice.why: The user needs a set audience reached before a date and wants to control how often they see it; only the Reach goal gives a frequency cap or weekly target.

not_chosen.why: Only 1 of the 4 creatives is a video (20 seconds), so a goal built on video watching would leave the images out.
Meta sets frequency for this goal, so the cap found below could not be applied.

rows_dropped.reason: ad set ended 2026-10-21, so it ran only part of the week

exposure_curve.level_off_rule: first graded band whose extra-exposure value is under 50% of the first band's value
exposure_curve.caveat: The curve pools 4 ad sets, two audiences and their creatives: it shows how this account's Reach spend behaved, not a controlled test.

body.name: Deposits reach, US 25 to 54, cap 4 per 7 days

payloads.note: Created paused. Check the cap in Ads Manager after creating: get_adsets can't read it back.

ads_manager_steps: Add the 3 images and the 20-second video as ads in the new ad set, then activate the campaign and ad set in Ads Manager.

If you prefer a weekly target frequency to a cap: in the ad set, under Frequency control, choose Target frequency and set the weekly average closest to 3.4 that Ads Manager offers. It needs the lifetime budget and no bid controls, which this plan already has.
Brand lift: Ads Manager, Experiments, create a test and look for Brand lift. If it isn't offered for this account and budget, ask a Meta rep.
connector_cannot: change or remove the cap on an existing ad set

read_out.check: week 1 and 2 frequency against the 3.4 target and 4 cap, CPM against $8.59 (flag over 20% above), and link clicks per 1,000 reached against the curve
